camel_example: aliyun ecs ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000,i-bp67acfmxazb4pi0000' --AutoRenew true --RenewalStatus AutoRenewal --Duration 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PeriodUnit Month
description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more subscription instances to help reduce the maintenance costs of expiring resources
description_zh: 本接口用于修改一台或多台包年包月实例的自动续费属性，可以帮助您减少资源到期的维护成本
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-instance-auto-renew-attribute --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000,i-bp67acfmxazb4pi0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --duration 1 --auto-renew true --renewal-status AutoRenewal --period-unit Month --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs. You can specify up to 100 subscription instance IDs at a time. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。支持批量设置最多100个包年包月实例，多个实例ID以英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instances. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration of the instance.

<props="china">
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "4", "5"}.
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "6", "12", "24", "36", "48", "60"}.
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Week`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "4"}.

</props>

<props="intl">
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "4", "5"}.
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "6", "12", "24", "36", "48", "60"}.

</props>

<props="partner">
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "4", "5"}.
- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values of `Duration` are: {"1", "2", "3", "6", "12", "24", "36", "48", "60"}.

</props>
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal before the instance expires.

- true: enables auto-renewal.
- false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
实例到期前是否自动续费。

- true：是。
- false：否。

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal status of ECS instance. Valid values:

- AutoRenewal: enables auto-renewal.

- Normal: disables auto-renewal.

- NotRenewal: does not renew ECS instance. After this value is specified, the system no longer sends expiration notifications. Only a non-renewal reminder is sent three days before ECS instance expires. You can change the value for an instance from NotRenewal to `Normal` and then manually renew ECS instance or configure auto-renewal.

> The `RenewalStatus` parameter takes precedence over the `AutoRenew` parameter. If `RenewalStatus` is not specified, the `AutoRenew` parameter is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
实例的自动续费状态。取值范围：

- AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

- Normal：取消自动续费。

- NotRenewal：不再续费。传入该值后，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒。不再续费的ECS实例可以更改成待续费（`Normal`）后，再自行续费或设置为自动续费。

> 参数`RenewalStatus`的优先级高于参数`AutoRenew`。如果不传入参数`RenewalStatus`，则默认以参数`AutoRenew`为准
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal duration specified by the `Duration` parameter. Valid values:

<props="china">
- Week
- Month (default)
- Year

</props>

<props="intl">
- Month (default)
- Year

</props>

<props="partner">
- Month (default)
- Year

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长的时间单位，即参数`Duration`的单位。取值范围：

<props="china">
- Week
- Month（默认）
- Year

</props>

<props="intl">

- Year

<props="partner">

- Year

</props>
parameters.name: period_unit
